name: Taalhaa Express Checkout for WooCommerce
author: taalhaa

sections.description:
Standard WooCommerce checkout flows often require multiple steps and numerous form fields, which can lead to friction when customers want to make a quick purchase.

Taalhaa Express Checkout for WooCommerce streamlines the ordering experience by introducing a lightweight, slide-in checkout modal directly on single product pages.

With just 3 essential fields (Full Name, Mobile Number, and Delivery Address), customers can place an order quickly and effortlessly.

🚀 Key Features (Version 1.0.0)

  • 1-Click “Buy Now” Button: Automatically placed next to the single product Add to Cart button.
  • Slide-In Checkout Modal: A clean, mobile-responsive popup window that opens without reloading the page.
  • Simplified 3-Field Form: Requests only Name, Phone, and Delivery Address.
  • Instant AJAX Order Processing: Creates WooCommerce orders in the background and redirects to the Order Received page.
  • Native COD Integration: Assigns Cash on Delivery as the default payment method for express orders.
  • Ultra-Lightweight & Zero Bloat: Built with 100% Vanilla JavaScript. No jQuery or heavy frameworks required.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables).
  • Accessibility Ready: Supports keyboard navigation (Escape key to dismiss) and standard ARIA attributes.

💡 Clean & Zero-Configuration Design

Taalhaa Express Checkout is designed to work immediately upon activation. It requires no complex configuration, enabling the express checkout flow seamlessly.

🌍 Built for Cash on Delivery Stores

Ideal for e-commerce stores offering Cash on Delivery (COD), allowing buyers to complete purchases with essential contact and delivery details.
sections.installation:
Installing Taalhaa Express Checkout is simple:

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and select the taalhaa-express-checkout.zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Visit any single product page on your store to see the “Buy Now” button in action.
sections.faq:
Does it support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes! Taalhaa Express Checkout is 100% compatible with HPOS (Custom Order Tables).

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is built with pure Vanilla JavaScript and minimal CSS. Assets are loaded only on single product pages.

How do I change the color of the “Buy Now” button?

The button uses a modern neutral theme by default. You can customize the appearance by adding CSS to your theme:
.taalhaa-fec-buy-now-btn { background-color: #0073aa !important; }

What payment method is used for these express orders?

The plugin processes express orders using Cash on Delivery (COD), allowing customers to complete orders quickly without upfront payment gateway steps.

Is this optimized for Cash on Delivery (COD) and dropshipping stores?

Yes! It is specifically engineered to maximize conversion rates for Cash on Delivery e-commerce stores in Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, the Middle East, and worldwide. By asking only for Name, Phone, and Delivery Address, it eliminates friction.

Can I automatically sync express orders to Google Sheets?

Yes! Combine it with our companion free plugin TSync Sheet for WooCommerce to automatically log customer names, phone numbers, addresses, and order details directly into your Google Spreadsheet in real time.

How do I recover customers who abandon before completing checkout?

Use our companion plugin TRecover – Cart Recovery for WooCommerce to automatically capture visitor contact info and send automated recovery reminder emails.

  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS.
